findings.text: The live guess still shows a sentence after it has been sent early. `build_tail()` (`ext/Chat/Mic.js:187`) draws all of `partial_text`, so the sentence appears twice on screen (the sent bubble plus the draft) until the final lands. If the final is slower than `paragraph_pause_ms` (2 s; the phone measured about 2.5 s in doc/upload.md), `auto_check()` → `send_screen()` (`Mic.js:690`) can send the box with that sentence in it again: a second copy, which ask 2 forbids. Trim the early-sent sentences out of the guess the caption draws, and test it with a slow final in `test/sentences.mjs`.

Ask 2's third bullet is not met: "the sentence that was already sent is corrected in place." `drop_early()` (`Mic.js` diff, after `early_from_guess`) keeps the early wording and only logs the difference, saying "no server-side in-place correction exists." A fix path does exist: `chat.fix` lines (`ux/Dictate/chat.js:286`) and `patch_piece()` (`ext/Chat/Chat.js:318`, used by `Widget.js:596`). Use one of them, or say in the report why neither fits. A silent limit fails "V1's raw text", because the Whisper final never reaches the screen.

The new setting is not indexed. `SETTINGS.early_sentences` (`ext/Chat/Mic.js:15`) is missing from `ext/Chat/doc/mic-notes.md#settings`, the section the SETTINGS comment points to. The two new proofs, `test/mic-release.mjs` and `test/sentences.mjs`, are missing from the proof list in `ux/Dictate/readme.md:41`. CLAUDE.md law 10 requires both.

Item 1's mic test never runs the surface the owner used. `test/mic-release.mjs` tests `Capture` and the base `Dictate`. It never tests `ComposerMic` or `DictationBar`'s tap-to-pause, which is the "paused" the owner saw, and it never tests resume after pause, which the brief asks for ("resume works"). Add a `DictationBar` tap → paused → tap → listening case that checks `readyState` at each step.

The timing check in `test/sentences.mjs:52` reads `a && b && c || d`. Because `&&` binds tighter than `||`, `A.marks[4] === 2` alone passes it. Parenthesise the `||` part, so the check really proves "each sentence sent as it ended."

In `send_screen()`, a split send of several lines skips `refine_final()` (`Mic.js` diff, `if (items.length === 1)`). The paragraphed clean-up now only runs on single-line sends. That trade-off is fine, but it should be written down in `doc/upload.md`.

`send_screen()` and `drop_early()` find the leftover tail by string length after `trim()` and `join(" ")`. Double spaces or newlines in the text shift the cut by a character. Slicing at the last match's `index + length` would be exact.
`doc/pipeline.md` (the path of one spoken sentence) does not mention the early send yet. Add one line at the guess step that links to upload.md.

findings.text: `drop_early()` (diff `ext/Chat/Mic.js`, `const all = …; last = all[mine.length - 1]; return last ? … : ""`) throws away new words when the final punctuates differently. Example: "The cat sat down." went out early, then the final is "The cat sat down and then it slept." That final holds one sentence, so the slice returns "" and "and then it slept" is never sent. The same happens to the whole final whenever it has fewer finished sentences than were sent early. Fix: when the final's sentences don't line up, cut by matching the early words (or send the unmatched remainder), and add this case to `test/sentences.mjs` (scenario C only covers the `!` variant).

Ask 2, third bullet ("corrected in place … never a second copy") is still unmet. The first review raised this (review.jsonl finding 2), and this round answers it with a claim in `ux/Dictate/doc/upload.md` ("Correction in place: not built … the `fix` line … renames a chat title") that the code contradicts. A `chat.fix` line with the same `at` already patches the drawn piece in place: `ext/Chat/Chat.js:788-794` (`fix_index.get(c.at)` → `Object.assign(hit.piece, {text})`) and `ux/Dictate/Widget.js:159-161`. The real gap may be only the Servex writer for an owner-line fix. Use that path, or name exactly what is missing, and correct the upload.md bullet either way.

`test/sentences.mjs` drives `early_from_guess()` and `commit()` by hand and sets `final_epoch` itself (line 392). The real wiring (`Dictate.js` interim handler → `early_from_guess(text, epoch)`, `close_segment()` → `final_epoch = epoch - 1`) reads correctly (`Dictate.js:526-562`), but no test runs it end to end through a stubbed Whisper the way `test/mic-release.mjs` does.

Several-line sends skip `refine_final()` (`if (items.length === 1)`). That trade-off is now written down in upload.md, which is fine. Early sends also carry `raw: null`, which is fine because the guess text is the raw Whisper text.
